result.markdown:
# High Latency in Grand Tunis due to Stadium Event

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-001`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by external event timing matching KPI spikes and confirmed absence of alarms.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-23 18:30 to 2026-09-23 22:15
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-23 18:32
- **Affected:** S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-010

## Summary

A football match at Stade Olympique de Rades caused a massive crowd surge, increasing active users and PRB utilization, leading to high latency.

High latency and increased traffic spikes on four sites in Grand Tunis from 18:30 to 22:15.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-23 18:30: Latency and PRB utilisation spike on S-TUN-010. [T1, T4]
- 2026-09-23 18:32: Football match starts at Stade Olympique de Rades. [EVT-004]
- 2026-09-23 18:45: Active users spike on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003. [T4]
- 2026-09-23 22:15: Impact ends as metrics recover across all affected sites. [T1, T4]
- 2026-09-23 22:26: Football match event concludes. [EVT-004]

## Evidence

- Active users, traffic, drop rate, latency, and PRB utilisation spiked on 4 sites. [ALR-0029]
- S-TUN-010 experienced a PRB utilisation spike to 95 percent. [ANM-000310]
- A football match near S-TUN-001 with expected attendance of 40,000 occurred. [EVT-004]
- No alarms were recorded on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-010 and descending nodes. [T3]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-001: confirmed. Stadium event timing matches the onset and recovery of traffic surges and latency spikes. [EVT-004, T1, T4]
2. **transport_failure** at S-TUN-010: rejected. No alarms were found on any of the affected sites during the incident window. [T3]

## Ruled out

- T3: No alarms were present on the affected nodes, ruling out internal network equipment failure.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor stadium event schedules proactively for future capacity planning.
- Implement temporary cell reconfigurations or mobile base stations near Stade Olympique de Rades during large matches.

report.title: High Latency in Grand Tunis due to Stadium Event

confounders.why: A real stadium event the same evening in the same region, but its venue is about 7 km from S-TUN-010; it explains the venue sites, not this site.
HIGH_PRB at a venue site, caused by the event.

truth.notes: trap=congestion_on_match_day; Demand surge saturated the radio resources of S-TUN-010, 7 km from the stadium; the match is real but is not the cause. Trap: a stadium event is on the calendar for the region and the evening, so a hasty investigator calls the congestion at S-TUN-010 expected. Settled by: (1) S-TUN-010 is not a venue site (near_venue is false, about 7 km away, under LNK-TUN-01-C while the venue sites hang under other links), and the event record names the venue; (2) latency and drop rate at the site are far worse than at the venue sites, whose extra capacity keeps them mild; (3) the runbook says an event far from the saturated site does not explain it.
